data.context: In the 2024 report *Computer Implemented Inventions: Patent Trends at IP Australia, EPO and USPTO*, this section examines whether past IP Australia computer-implemented invention (CII) patent applicants continued applying for CII patents after 2014. It reports estimated changes in application propensity, including results for applicants with CII-PSM-likely-adverse applications and for a 2010–19 sample.
